description:
**Machine Learning Engineer**

**A US-headquartered product company scaling its India hub**

**Location:**
Remote (India)

**About the Company**

A US-headquartered product company with a large, established customer base is scaling its India engineering hub and has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Machine Learning Engineer for its core platform team. The team owns ML features that already run in production at scale and need an engineer who can extend and harden them. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

**Role Overview**

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will build, evaluate, and ship models into the company's production product, working closely with backend and platform engineers to keep inference reliable at scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Model Development**

* Design, train, and evaluate ML models for ranking, recommendation, or NLP use cases within the product
* Run structured experiments and A/B tests to validate model impact against product metrics
* Iterate on features, labels, and model architecture based on production feedback

**Production & Platform**

* Build and maintain training and inference pipelines that run reliably at scale
* Own model deployment, versioning, monitoring, and rollback in production
* Partner with backend engineers to integrate models into existing services with low latency

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 2 to 6 years building and shipping ML models into production systems
* Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow
* Comfortable with the full lifecycle from data pipelines to deployed, monitored models
* Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote-work setup

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with MLOps tooling such as MLflow, Airflow, or Kubeflow
* Exposure to large-scale data systems (Spark, feature stores, or streaming pipelines)
* A degree in computer science, statistics, or a related quantitative field

**What We Offer**

* A core ML seat embedded in a US product company's India engineering hub
* Remote-friendly, pan-India hiring with long-term placement
* Direct exposure to production-scale ML systems and senior engineering leadership
* One application considered for this and future matched roles

**Hiring Process**

HR Screening → Technical Assessment → System Design Round → Culture Fit

* Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage time effectively, and communicate clearly with team members.

* Manage development artifacts using PackMan and JDE Object Management Workbench (OMW).
* Ensure the scalability, security, and performance of JDE custom solutions
* Support deployment and release management processes.
* Work within a global team and ensure alignment with corporate IT strategies

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong (10+ years) experience in JD Edwards EnterpriseOne CNC, development and administration.
* Proven track record of conducting a minimum of three development projects in a JDE environment, preferably in the medical industry.
* Experience in computerized system validated/regulated environments with GxP compliance.
* Experience in automating JDE development and deployment processes.
* Hands-on expertise in JDE Object Management Workbench (OMW) and Pack Man.
* Solid understanding of DevOps methodologies, software development lifecycle, and best practices.
* Have a strong understanding and working experience with Agile approach and culture.
* Proven experience in code and performance reviews, technical quality assurance.
* Familiarity with JDE customizations and their impact on global business processes.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a complex, highly customized JDE environment.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with external partners and internal teams.
* Experience with ARCtool solution.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of JDE architecture and performance optimization techniques.
* Experience working in multi-national, large-scale JDE environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL methodologies and incident/change management processes.

**Job Summary**
We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle—from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans.
* Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability.
* Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices.
* Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities.
* Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics.
* Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability.
* Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/.NET and related technologies.
* Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments.
* Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration.
* Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates.
* Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems.
* Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases.
* Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks.
* Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry.
* Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation.
* Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems.
* Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule.
* Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring.
* Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums.

* 12–18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment.
* B.E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field
* Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering.
* Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/.NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems.

**Preferred Skills**

Vortenza Systems provides students and graduates with practical exposure to data science and emerging technologies. The organization focuses on developing real-world technical and analytical skills through hands-on projects, mentorship, and industry-oriented learning experiences.

As a Data Science Intern, you will assist in analyzing datasets, developing data-driven solutions, and applying statistical and machine learning techniques to practical problems.

The role will provide practical exposure to data preprocessing, exploratory analysis, model development, evaluation, and visualization.

• Collect, clean, and preprocess datasets for analysis

• Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns and trends

• Apply basic statistical and analytical techniques to datasets

• Evaluate model performance and document results

• Assist in preparing reports and project presentations

• Research relevant data science techniques and tools

• Collaborate with team members on practical data science projects

ELIGIBILITY

• Currently pursuing or recently graduated in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field

• Strong interest in data science, analytics, and machine learning

• Willingness to learn and work on practical projects

• Basic knowledge of Python

• Understanding of statistics and data analysis concepts

• Familiarity with Pandas, NumPy, or similar libraries is preferred

• Basic understanding of machine learning concepts is preferred

• Good analytical and problem-solving skills

• Good communication and teamwork skills

• Opportunity to work on real-world data science projects

• Practical industry exposure and mentorship

• Performance-based stipend up to ₹7,500/-
